notes.title: Release 30.05.2019
notes.notes:
[b]SKAT[/b] is a [b]trick-taking card game[/b] with 3 players very similar to [b]SPADES[/b], and national game of Germany.

Every single hand, [b]first[/b] the one who plays against 2 others  has to be determined. This is done by the auction (German: "Reizen") meaning [b]betting and competing[/b], player with strongest bet may define the Trump suit - but  plays against 2 others!

You'll find a step-by-step Tutorial clicking "Extras" > "Tutorial"
